name: Citicoline
sections: White crystalline powder (sodium salt), freely soluble in water.

Citicoline occurs naturally in all cells as an intermediate of phosphatidylcholine synthesis; it is a prescription drug in many European and Asian countries and a supplement elsewhere. The ICTUS trial (2012) did not show benefit in moderate-to-severe acute ischaemic stroke. First approval/introduction: Developed in Japan and Spain in the 1970s (Ferrer Internacional).

Intermediate in phosphatidylcholine synthesis; supports neuronal membrane repair, increases acetylcholine and dopamine availability, reduces free-fatty-acid release and free-radical damage after ischaemic or traumatic brain injury. Receptor / target profile: Intermediate in phosphatidylcholine synthesis; increases acetylcholine, dopamine and norepinephrine levels, decreases glutamate and free fatty acids, and preserves membrane phospholipids.
Hydrolysed in gut wall and liver to choline and cytidine (uridine), which cross the blood–brain barrier and resynthesise CDP-choline
Summary: Oral bioavailability >90%; hydrolysed to choline and cytidine, which cross the blood–brain barrier and are resynthesised. Eliminated via respiration (CO2) and urine.
Acute ischaemic stroke and recovery phase
Cognitive and behavioural disorders of degenerative or vascular origin
Acute stroke/head injury: 500–2000 mg/day IV (slow injection over 3–5 min or infusion) or IM
Usual oral maintenance: 500–1000 mg/day in 1–2 doses
Dose to be individualised by the treating physician according to clinical response and tolerability.
Insufficient data; use only if clearly needed.
Marked hypertonia of the parasympathetic system
In acute intracranial haemorrhage, do not exceed recommended doses and give slowly by injection
Not to be combined with meclofenoxate-containing products
Dávalos et al., Stroke 2002 – pooled analysis suggested improved recovery after ischaemic stroke.
ICTUS (Dávalos et al., Lancet 2012) – no benefit in moderate-to-severe acute ischaemic stroke.
Store below 30°C in a dry place, protected from light and moisture. Keep out of the reach of children. Do not use after the expiry date.
